heroHeadline: DCI Names Four Officers in Kiprotich Abduction as Foreign-Trader Crackdown Sends Hundreds of Burundians Fleeing to Their Embassy
heroSubtitle: Investigators say police sought the same CCTV footage IPOA is using to reconstruct journalist Alex Kiprotich's September 1 abduction, raising cover-up concerns, while President Ruto's order to shut foreign-run small businesses has triggered panic among Kenya's roughly 16,000 Burundian refugees and asylum seekers
